tool.name: shopify_catalog_products
tool.title: Shopify Store Products, Prices & Stock
tool.description:
Read the full public product catalog of any Shopify store, collection or single product and return one row per product (or one row per variant): title, product URL, vendor, product type, tags, SKU list, price range, compare-at price, stock status, variant-level prices and availability, option names/values, image URLs and updated timestamps.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/shopify-catalog-prices-scraper'.
- Side Effects: Reads the store's public /products.json feed and creates a billed Actor run and dataset on your Apify account. No login, cookies or proxies are used.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typically 1-5 seconds per store for a few hundred products; starts from $0.001 per row plus a small per-run start fee. One call returns at most 100 rows, and every row the Actor produces is billed, so keep stores x max_products at or below 100 (one_row_per_variant multiplies rows by the variant count).

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for price monitoring, competitor catalog research, stock checks, SKU harvesting and product-feed building for public Shopify storefronts.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for stores whose products.json is disabled or password-protected (they return 404 and are reported in the run log), for private customer or order data, or for non-Shopify shops (the WooCommerce Store API is a different endpoint).
- Named alternatives: Use 'apple_app_store_data' for iOS app metadata and chart rankings; use the marketplace lead-database Actors when you need merchant contact emails rather than product data.

Honest limits: prices are in the store's own currency (Shopify's public feed never states a currency, so none is invented); pagination stops at max_products per store or the end of the feed, whichever comes first; a run that returns zero rows fails loudly rather than reporting success.

stores.description: Public Shopify stores to read: a domain ('allbirds.com'), a full collection URL ('https://store.com/collections/sale') or a single product URL.

max_products.description: Stop after this many products per store. Each returned product (or variant) is one billed row; defaults to 25.

one_row_per_variant.description: Return one row per variant instead of one per product, for SKU-level price and stock data. Each row is billed.

only_in_stock.description: Skip products whose variants are all out of stock.

storeDomain.title: Store domain
storeDomain.description: Domain the products were read from.

productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: Shopify numeric product id as a string; primary key within a store.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.description: Brand or vendor field as set by the merchant.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: Collection handle when a collection URL was scraped.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Lowest variant price, in the store's own currency.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Highest variant price, in the store's own currency.

compareAtMax.title: Max compare-at price
compareAtMax.description: Highest compare-at (original) price, when the merchant sets one.

available.title: Any variant in stock
available.description: True if at least one variant is available.

variantCount.title: Variant count
variantCount.description: Number of variants on the product.

availableVariantCount.title: Available variants
availableVariantCount.description: Number of variants currently in stock.

skus.title: SKUs
skus.description: All non-empty SKUs of the product.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the product's last update in the store.

verification.how: Apify test run of actor QuRuupSWNf0fzjBOL with input {"stores":["allbirds.com"],"maxProductsPerStore":3} on 2026-11-12, plus a full public-store run on allbirds.com that paginated 250 products.
verification.result: SUCCEEDED in ~1s, 3 rows returned. Sample row: productId 7292464824400, title "Women's Wool Cruiser - Port (Port Sole)", url https://allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-cruiser-port-port-sole, minPrice 120, maxPrice 120, 13 variants, 3 available, real SKUs and cdn.shopify.com image URLs.
